metrics.layer_count_definition: Nondecreasing receiving-body/root support courses; not hanging-tip bottomZ or slicing layers.

descriptive_pattern_metrics.scope: Occupied8mm/4.8mm source sample andwhole-part palette projectedonto the same normalizedbody. Excludes studs,gaps,chamfers andsupports; realCGmustbeviewed separately.

front.interpretation: Descriptive projected geometry overlap/boundary distance; no aesthetic or mechanical pass threshold

side.interpretation: Descriptive projected geometry overlap/boundary distance; no aesthetic or mechanical pass threshold

painted_feature_region.interpretation: Nearest source palette labels on actual registered visible surfaces. Face pose, color regions and gaps influence this statistic; it does not declare likeness approval.

descriptive_pattern_metrics.region_definition: Tight reference-front bbox of all non-base colorcells plus5pixels; not automatic anatomical landmark detection.
descriptive_pattern_metrics.interpretation: Differences are descriptive. Morepieces are not a validated likeness percentage or mechanical completion.

front.framing_method: Actual native vertex projection, not empty bounding-box corners; center and screen-height normalization per model.
front.normalization_note: The four shapes occupy equal screen height; this image group is NOT a physical size comparison.

three_quarter.framing_method: Actual native vertex projection, not empty bounding-box corners; center and screen-height normalization per model.
three_quarter.normalization_note: The four shapes occupy equal screen height; this image group is NOT a physical size comparison.

limitations_ja: 倍率は実部品数で、寸法倍率ではありません。比較1xは本人不在時の暫定前提です。
完成サイズ増加で元形状の相対格子解像度を上げていますが、色境界は初期C参照で、美観改善の保証ではありません。
放射状分解は説明図。物理的に衝突せず分解できる保証ではありません。下からの順序は公称支持の検査で、保持力は未確認です。
元の本体内の実部品を一体の受け・根元へ再構成し、外付け/仮の組立支台を不要とする候補です。実CADの接触・挿入・断面・全荷重prefixを検査済みですが、現物保持力や印刷時サポート不要は未確認です。
limitations_en: The multiplier is actual physicalpiececount, not linearsize. The1xbaseline is a provisional creator assumption while the user was unavailable.
Larger fixed-pitch sampling increases relative contour resolution; colors reference initialC. More parts do not guarantee better appearance.
Radial explosion is explanatory, not collision-free physical disassembly. Bottom-up order has nominal support checks, not verified retention.

Existing body material is joined into real seated internal supports, with no external or temporary assembly stands. Native contact/insertion/sections/all nominal load prefixes are checked; physical retention and slicer-support requirements remain unvalidated.

assembly_support.method: Real continuous same-color stepped beam/root modules; unchanged body envelope and 8mm root interfaces, no floor stands.

observations_ja: 新actualID copilot-p200-support-free-v2は実35,630部品・182型、固定分母17,873/目標35,746との差-116で許容内。旧35,648部品のうち既存19個を実1個の本体受けへ統合した差-18で、床柱や重りの追加ではない。
完成正面・斜め・放射分解・登録正面の実CG4枚、実144frame/12fps/12秒/3章動画のframe1/18/54/73/108/144と取付周辺74/75/76/77を閲覧した。顔・ゴーグル・輪郭・色を維持し、旧支台は写っていない。元占有セル・全色・非変更部品poseも保持している。
BS-f1562cd26f18d2e0は191.8x231.8x4.8mm、141実接点の単一course受け。真の底面と受けZは16.0mmで、既存本体course3の後にrootcourse4/newstep382を取り付ける。見えない柱へ改名した構造ではない。
実native単一solid・接触/bearing・非干渉・挿入・全support/insertion先行関係、元/別展開の全ID/type/color/pose/stepを照合した。根元自身と後続荷重の全63prefixで最小28.935340mmの公称CAD静モーメント余裕を確認し、1mm基準は不変。
全51XY断面は正面積で最小52.588563mm²、真の下面屋根1.6mm。body_slices1要素の単一courseに実Z段差はなく、public proofのsection_applicabilityで期待Z面空/XYのみ必須/NOT_APPLICABLE_SINGLE_COURSEを明記した。
適用条件の補足は全出力完成後のmetadata-only再bindとし、nativeFCStd/STEP/STL/mesh・4PNG・MP4の全bytesを保持した。保存sceneは全35,630instance/182実mesh、材質/pose/step、絶対放射復帰、本体0→全数を再照合し、CGや動画を作り直していない。
実外部/仮支台は0個。広い薄型根元の実印刷変形、PLA/infill、保持力、曲げ、クリープ、転倒や手のアクセスは未検証で、外観採用・印刷は保留。旧case、他11案、基準/4倍、旧型・画像・比較のbytesは変更していない。
observations_en: Actual35,630pieces/182types for copilot-p200-support-free-v2. The fixed17,873denominator and35,746target are unchanged; difference-116 is within tolerance. Nineteen existing parts become one real body root, reducing the old35,648count by18 without adding a floor post or ballast.

All four real CG views, actual144-frame/12fps/12-second/three-chapter movie samples1/18/54/73/108/144 and installation samples74/75/76/77 were inspected. Face, goggles, silhouette and colors remain; the old aid is absent. Source occupied cells, all colors and unaffected poses are preserved.

BS-f1562cd26f18d2e0 measures191.8x231.8x4.8mm with141actual root contacts in one course. Physical bottom and receiving Z are16.0mm; body receiver course3 precedes rootcourse4/newstep382. It is not a renamed hidden floor pillar.

Actual native single-solid/contact/bearing/noninterference/insertion and all support/insertion predecessor checks pass. Original and relocated native reopening match every ID/type/color/pose/step. All63module/payload prefixes have minimum nominal CAD static margin28.935340mm, retaining the1mm requirement.

All51native X/Ysections are positive, minimum52.588563mm2, with1.6mm true cavity roof. The one-element body_slices topology has no internal Z step. Public section_applicability explicitly records no expected Z planes, X/Yrequirements and NOT_APPLICABLE_SINGLE_COURSE.

Applicability was rebound only after all outputs completed. Every nativeFCStd/STEP/STL/mesh,4PNG and MP4byte remains unchanged. The saved scene re-verifies all35,630instances/182native meshes, materials/poses/steps, absolute radial return and empty-to-full animation without re-rendering CG or video.

There are zero actual external/temporary assembly aids. Physical warping of the broad thin root, PLA/infill behavior, retention, bending, creep, tipping and hand access are untested; appearance selection and printing remain on hold. Historical cases, other11designs,1x/4x, old types/images/comparisons are unchanged.
